dossier.scp_unleashed.294.title: The Coffee Machine
dossier.scp_unleashed.294.caption: SCP-294 at intake. The cup in front was still warm.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-294 stands in a locked break room under camera. It may be used only with written approval, and every request is logged word for word. %rUnapproved requests are a disciplinary matter.%r
Cups whose contents cannot be identified are not to be drunk. They are sealed in a storage container for study.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-294 is a black drinks vending machine about two metres tall, with chrome trim and a backlit picture of three coffee cups on stone pillars. Where its selection buttons should be, it has a typewriter keyboard.

When a small iron coin is fed in, the user can type the name of almost any liquid. SCP-294 whirrs, drops a paper cup into its alcove, fills it and pushes it out. The contents always match the request, however unlikely. Most cups are harmless. Some are not.
When a request makes no sense to it, SCP-294 shows OUT OF RANGE on its display and gives the coin back.

page.title: Addendum 294-1: Request Log
text: Request: coffee. Result: strong black coffee. Researcher Hale finished his double shift early.
Request: the ocean. Result: a cold, salty cup that smelled of rain. D-3318 could hear surf for an hour afterwards.
Request: a cup of a cup. Result: OUT OF RANGE.
Request: arsenic. Result: exactly what was asked for. The cup was confiscated on its way to the Theodore wing.
Request: %rsomething to believe in%r. Result: a cup of white light. The subject rose from the floor and was not recovered. %rRequests of this kind are now prohibited.%r

page.title: Addendum 294-2: Recovery
page.text: SCP-294 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. Asked how it had been carried, the individual did not answer. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp294_machine.1: SCP-294 is a drinks machine with a keyboard. Use it, type the name of a liquid and press DISPENSE. Each cup costs one iron nugget from your inventory.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp294_machine.2: It will pour almost anything that can be poured. Some orders come back OUT OF RANGE, and some cups are not meant for people.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp294_machine.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-294 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; the machine turns up nearby soon after.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp294_cup.1: A paper cup poured by SCP-294. Hold use to drink it. What it does depends on what was ordered.
